notes: Car soccer is decided by goals on an enclosed pitch, not by a lap or a finish line, so it is Sports rather than Racing, and the Physics Sport preset is built for exactly this arena: goal mouths as scoring volumes, a closed perimeter wall that keeps ball and players in, and a centre reset position to restart play. space-bounded is the genre default and correct here — one rigid bounded field with teams inside it. I added spectator-bleachers on top of the preset because the scale answer asks for a stadium shell that reads as an arena, and that stepped seating is what carries the tiered flag; it is relief with no overhang, so the build stays on P0. Decided without a user: no foul boundary, because in this sport the walls are in play and nothing goes out of bounds, and the cars, boost and aerial control are mechanics that reach no layout pick.
